chunks: That is God, your Lord; there is no god but He, the creator of all things. So pay homage to Him, for He takes care of everything.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God being the Creator and Guardian of all things?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse establishes the foundation of Tawhid by linking God's creative power (Khaliq) with His sustaining governance (Wakil), affirming that worship is the natural response to His absolute lordship. The command to 'worship Him' is often interpreted by scholars like Al-Tabarsi as encompassing both ritual devotion and recognizing His exclusive authority in all affairs, reinforcing the concept of divine unity against polytheism.
